en.text: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

zhSimplified.text: 王的心在耶和华手中， 好像陇沟的水随意流转。

zhTraditional.text: 王的心在耶和華手中， 好像隴溝的水隨意流轉。

en.text: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

zhSimplified.text: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看为正； 惟有耶和华衡量人心。

zhTraditional.text: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看為正； 惟有耶和華衡量人心。

en.text: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

zhSimplified.text: 行仁义公平 比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。

zhTraditional.text: 行仁義公平 比獻祭更蒙耶和華悅納。

en.text: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人发达，眼高心傲， 这乃是罪。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人發達，眼高心傲， 這乃是罪。

en.text: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

zhSimplified.text: 殷勤筹划的，足致丰裕； 行事急躁的，都必缺乏。

zhTraditional.text: 殷勤籌劃的，足致豐裕； 行事急躁的，都必缺乏。

en.text: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

zhSimplified.text: 用诡诈之舌求财的，就是自己取死； 所得之财乃是吹来吹去的浮云。

zhTraditional.text: 用詭詐之舌求財的，就是自己取死； 所得之財乃是吹來吹去的浮雲。

en.text: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人的强暴必将自己扫除， 因他们不肯按公平行事。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人的強暴必將自己掃除， 因他們不肯按公平行事。

en.text: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

zhSimplified.text: 负罪之人的路甚是弯曲； 至于清洁的人，他所行的乃是正直。

zhTraditional.text: 負罪之人的路甚是彎曲； 至於清潔的人，他所行的乃是正直。

en.text: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

zhSimplified.text: 宁可住在房顶的角上， 不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。

zhTraditional.text: 寧可住在房頂的角上， 不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。

en.text: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人的心乐人受祸； 他眼并不怜恤邻舍。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人的心樂人受禍； 他眼並不憐恤鄰舍。

en.text: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 亵慢的人受刑罚，愚蒙的人就得智慧； 智慧人受训诲，便得知识。

zhTraditional.text: 褻慢的人受刑罰，愚蒙的人就得智慧； 智慧人受訓誨，便得知識。

en.text: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

zhSimplified.text: 义人思想恶人的家， 知道恶人倾倒，必致灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 義人思想惡人的家， 知道惡人傾倒，必致滅亡。

en.text: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

zhSimplified.text: 塞耳不听穷人哀求的， 他将来呼吁也不蒙应允。

zhTraditional.text: 塞耳不聽窮人哀求的， 他將來呼籲也不蒙應允。

en.text: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

zhSimplified.text: 暗中送的礼物挽回怒气； 怀中搋的贿赂止息暴怒。

zhTraditional.text: 暗中送的禮物挽回怒氣； 懷中搋的賄賂止息暴怒。

en.text: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 秉公行义使义人喜乐， 使作孽的人败坏。

zhTraditional.text: 秉公行義使義人喜樂， 使作孽的人敗壞。

en.text: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

zhSimplified.text: 迷离通达道路的， 必住在阴魂的会中。

zhTraditional.text: 迷離通達道路的， 必住在陰魂的會中。

en.text: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

zhSimplified.text: 爱宴乐的，必致穷乏； 好酒，爱膏油的，必不富足。

zhTraditional.text: 愛宴樂的，必致窮乏； 好酒，愛膏油的，必不富足。

en.text: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人作了义人的赎价； 奸诈人代替正直人。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人作了義人的贖價； 奸詐人代替正直人。

en.text: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

zhSimplified.text: 宁可住在旷野， 不与争吵使气的妇人同住。

zhTraditional.text: 寧可住在曠野， 不與爭吵使氣的婦人同住。

en.text: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人家中积蓄宝物膏油； 愚昧人随得来随吞下。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人家中積蓄寶物膏油； 愚昧人隨得來隨吞下。

en.text: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

zhSimplified.text: 追求公义仁慈的， 就寻得生命、公义，和尊荣。

zhTraditional.text: 追求公義仁慈的， 就尋得生命、公義，和尊榮。

en.text: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人爬上勇士的城墙， 倾覆他所倚靠的坚垒。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人爬上勇士的城牆， 傾覆他所倚靠的堅壘。

en.text: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

zhSimplified.text: 谨守口与舌的， 就保守自己免受灾难。

zhTraditional.text: 謹守口與舌的， 就保守自己免受災難。

en.text: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

zhSimplified.text: 心骄气傲的人名叫亵慢； 他行事狂妄，都出于骄傲。

zhTraditional.text: 心驕氣傲的人名叫褻慢； 他行事狂妄，都出於驕傲。

en.text: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人的心愿将他杀害， 因为他手不肯做工。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人的心願將他殺害， 因為他手不肯做工。

en.text: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

zhSimplified.text: 有终日贪得无厌的； 义人施舍而不吝惜。

zhTraditional.text: 有終日貪得無饜的； 義人施捨而不吝惜。

en.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

zhSimplified.text: 恶人的祭物是可憎的； 何况他存恶意来献呢？

zhTraditional.text: 惡人的祭物是可憎的； 何況他存惡意來獻呢？

en.text: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

zhSimplified.text: 作假见证的必灭亡； 惟有听真情而言的，其言长存。

zhTraditional.text: 作假見證的必滅亡； 惟有聽真情而言的，其言長存。

en.text: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人脸无羞耻； 正直人行事坚定。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人臉無羞恥； 正直人行事堅定。

en.text: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 没有人能以智慧、聪明、 谋略敌挡耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 沒有人能以智慧、聰明、 謀略敵擋耶和華。

en.text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 马是为打仗之日预备的； 得胜乃在乎耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 馬是為打仗之日預備的； 得勝乃在乎耶和華。
